name: technology-selection
category: Engineering · Project request → stack & architecture decision → execution plan
description: Selects the technology stack, tools, and architecture for a project. Inspects the file system to decide between initializing a pnpm monorepo and adding artifacts to an existing one, applies the default React + TypeScript + Vite CSR frontend stack with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, a Node.js + TypeScript backend, pnpm and Biome tooling, and records a mandatory execution plan before any scaffolding runs.
